reviews.comment: This is a very strange professor. Her personality is super strange, and she makes it obvious that she is a hardcore raging liberal, who won't like you if you're basically a regular dude like me. Makes super inappropriate comments to students. Avoid. The material itself is super simple and easy, but she makes the class so unbearable.

ANTH 210. Easy class, Go to class, do your assignments, participate in class, DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. She is as good it gets. Cares about the students and the course. very organized and fun to learn from.

Very easy if you put in minimal effort. I am an ELEN major and didn't want to add too much work to my load, but it was extremely manageable and she was very understanding. Be warned though, she makes no secret of her left leaning political views, which can be irritating at times, but if you can ignore it, it is a very interesting and easy class.

Professor Brooks is the best professor I have had in 4 years at A&M. She actually makes lectures interesting and the topics each week were fun. There's a decent amount of work outside of class, but nothing that I thought was unreasonable. She tells you everything you need to get an A, which is very attainable. She's the best!!

I don't know why these ratings are as high as they are. Ridiculously long final project, took off 10 points because citations were "not uniform". Another 10 for content even though we were given almost no direction of what content to use. Fill in the blank on the final exam where you have to memorize words in the Inca language. TAKE ANY OTHER PROF!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ridiculously hard for a blow-off class. If you miss more than twice you can't get an A. Unnecessarily hard tests that are open response, multiple choice, and fill-in-the-blank. Take any other professor

5/11 discussions to do
1 article essay from a peer-reviewed journal
1 group project & presentation
3 exams
she's a good professor, really caring and offers extra credit throughout the course. go to her office hours, you can gain credit back going over the exams if there is any erorr. also def study for the exams thoroughly, don't try bs-ing it

reviews.comment: I loved Catherine! She is a super understanding prof and is willing to give extensions if things come up. You can tell she is very passionate about the subject because she puts her all into the lectures. You definitely do have to study for this class, but I found the material very interesting because of her. Opportunities for extra credit as well!

Just wanted to say that Prof Brooks is an extremely nice lady. Although if you think this is going to be a blow-off class to get an easy credit you are wrong. This is not the hardest class I have taken but it was not easy by any means. Unlike the previous reviews, there are not only two tests for this course, there are now three.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing grad student professor who is considerate of undergrad students. If you pay attention in class and study a week in advance for the test, tests are not difficult. There are only 4 assignments (2 writing and 2 tests): so go to class for points (10%) and make sure to use Grammarly to check your writing. Learned a lot of interesting content.

Very laid back class. 3 major assignments (mostly participation) & extra credit. Hard to know what's on exams sometimes since lecture style is conversational. Catherine is very outgoing and has lots of discussions. Lectures sometimes seemed boring but she tried to make it fun by having discussions and doing deep dives. Learned a lot regardless

It has been a joy to be a student of professor Brooks this semester. She is very kind and caring, as well as passionate and knowledgeable about the topics she teaches. I would encourage you to take her class if possible. She is amazing and works hard to make the lectures interesting and engaging. I love how open she is with the class :D
